prompt:
The section sections/collage-section-2.liquid currently renders every block as a collage tile using the block's requested size. Change its behaviour as described below. Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte. Keep the existing whitespace-control style so the output has no whitespace or newlines between tags. Inputs: - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.max_large: integer >= 0, or null. Null means no limit. - section.blocks: an array, possibly empty. Each element has a settings object: - block.settings.title: string or null. - block.settings.size: string or null. It is normally "small" or "large". Rules: 1. A block is visible only if its title is non-empty after strip. A null title counts as empty. Invisible blocks are skipped entirely: they produce no output, get no number and do not affect the state used by rules 3-4. 2. If there are no visible blocks, output nothing at all (empty string). 3. Each visible tile gets an effective size. It is "large" only when all of the following hold: - The block's size is exactly "large". - The previously rendered tile's effective size was not large. The first tile has no previous tile. - Fewer than max_large tiles have been rendered as large so far, or max_large is null. 4. Otherwise the effective size is "small". This covers any other size value, including null and "medium". 5. Only tiles whose effective size is large count toward max_large. A large request that is demoted does not count. 6. Visible tiles are numbered 1, 2, 3... in order. Skipped blocks are not counted. Output, in order: -
- If the stripped heading is non-empty:

HEADING

, with HEADING stripped and HTML-escaped. -
    - One
  • NTITLE
    • per visible tile. SIZE is the effective size; TITLE is stripped and HTML-escaped. -
Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/collage-section-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
